book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: باريس محاصرة، والناس جوعانة، والعصافير اختفت من السطوح.
sentences.en: Paris besieged, the people starving, the sparrows gone from the rooftops.

sentences.ar: والسيد موريسو، ساعاتي، ماشي بالشارع، وبطنه فاضي، وإيديه بجيوبه.
sentences.en: And Monsieur Morissot, a watchmaker, walking down the street, his belly empty, his hands in his pockets.

sentences.ar: وشاف رجل واقف، وعرفه: السيد سوفاج، صاحب دكان خردوات، وصاحبه من الصيد.
sentences.en: And saw a man standing there, and knew him: Monsieur Sauvage, a haberdasher, and his fishing companion.

sentences.ar: قبل الحرب، كل أحد كانوا يروحوا سوا للنهر، خارج المدينة، ويصيدوا.
sentences.en: Before the war, every Sunday they went together to the river, outside the city, and fished.

sentences.ar: من الفجر للمسا، جنب بعض، بلا كلام.
sentences.en: From dawn to dusk, side by side, without talk.
And those were the finest hours of their lives.
And now, they stood, shook hands, and sighed.
Sauvage said: what times!
Morissot said: and the fishing!
Do you remember the fishing?

sentences.ar: ودخلوا مقهى، وشربوا كاس، وبعدين كاس تاني.
sentences.en: And they went into a café, drank a glass, and then another.
And the wine began to talk.
Sauvage said: what if we went fishing.
Morissot said: where?
The German army is at the river.

sentences.ar: قال سوفاج: بعرف الكولونيل اللي على الخط.
sentences.en: Sauvage said: I know the colonel on the line.
He will give us a pass.

sentences.ar: وراحوا، وأخدوا التصريح، وجابوا عدة الصيد من بيوتهم.
sentences.en: And they went, got the pass, and fetched their fishing tackle from their houses.

sentences.ar: ومشوا خارج المدينة، بالضباب، لحد النهر.
sentences.en: And walked out of the city, in the mist, to the river.
The land empty.
The houses empty.
And the villages they had known, burned.
And they said: perhaps we meet Germans.
And Morissot said: we give them fish.
And laughed, afraid.

sentences.ar: ووصلوا للنهر، وقعدوا بمكانهم القديم، تحت الشجرة، ورموا الخيط.
sentences.en: And they reached the river, sat in their old place, under the tree, and cast their lines.
And after a minute, a fish.
And then another.

sentences.ar: كان النهر مليان سمك، لأنه ما حدا صاد من شهور.
sentences.en: The river was full of fish, because no one had fished for months.

sentences.ar: وصاروا يطلعوا سمك ورا سمك، والكيس بيعبي، والفرح بقلبهم.
sentences.en: And they pulled up fish after fish, the bag filling, joy in their hearts.

sentences.ar: وفوقهم، عالجبل، المدفع الفرنسي بيضرب، والألماني بيرد.
sentences.en: And above them, on the hill, the French cannon firing, and the German answering.

sentences.ar: قال موريسو: بيقتلوا بعض، وإحنا بنصيد.
sentences.en: Morissot said: they kill each other, and we fish.
Sauvage said: that is war.
Stupidity.

sentences.ar: ناس ما بتعرف بعض بتقتل بعض.
sentences.en: People who do not know each other kill each other.
And they were silent, and fished.
And then they heard feet behind their backs.

sentences.ar: ولفوا، وشافوا أربع رجال، بشوارب، وخوذ، وبنادق.
sentences.en: And turned, and saw four men, with moustaches, helmets, rifles.
Germans.

sentences.ar: وأخدوهم لجزيرة زغيرة بالنهر، فيها بيت، والضابط قاعد بالحديقة بيدخن.
sentences.en: And took them to a small island in the river, with a house, and the officer sitting in the garden smoking.

sentences.ar: قال الضابط، بفرنسي منيح: صيد حلو.
sentences.en: The officer said, in good French: fine fishing.
But you are not fishermen.
You are spies.
Morissot said: no!
Fishermen!
We have the pass!

sentences.ar: قال الضابط: كل جاسوس معه تصريح.
sentences.en: The officer said: every spy has a pass.

sentences.ar: وقال: عندكم كلمة السر عشان ترجعوا على المدينة، صح؟
sentences.en: And said: you have the password to get back into the city, correct?
Give it to me, and you go.
Otherwise I shoot you.
Now.

sentences.ar: الصاحبين وقفوا جنب بعض، وإيديهم بترجف، وما حكوا.
sentences.en: The two friends stood side by side, their hands shaking, and did not speak.
The officer said: I give you five minutes.
Think of your families.

sentences.ar: وأخد موريسو على جنب، وقال له بصوت واطي: احكي لي الكلمة، وصاحبك ما بيعرف.
sentences.en: And took Morissot aside, and told him in a low voice: tell me the word, and your friend will not know.
And you go.
Morissot did not answer.
And took Sauvage, and said the same.
Sauvage did not answer.
And they stood them side by side, by the water.

sentences.ar: وموريسو تطلع بكيس السمك، اللي بيتحرك عالعشب.
sentences.en: And Morissot looked at the bag of fish, moving on the grass.

sentences.ar: وقال: مع السلامة يا سيد سوفاج.
sentences.en: And said: goodbye, Monsieur Sauvage.

sentences.ar: وقال سوفاج: مع السلامة يا سيد موريسو.
sentences.en: And Sauvage said: goodbye, Monsieur Morissot.
And they shook hands, their hands shaking.
And they shot them, and threw them into the river.

sentences.ar: والضابط أخد كيس السمك، وقال للطباخ: اقليهم بسرعة، وهم لسا حيين.
sentences.en: And the officer took the bag of fish, and said to the cook: fry them at once, while they are still alive.
And went back to his smoking.
